sentences.text: Kuiornis indicator was an extinct wren belonging to the family Acanthisittidae.
Worthy and colleagues described the genus Kuiornis in 2010, containing only the species Kuiornis indicator, known from a single holotype consisting of a proximal right tarsometatarsus.
Fossils date to the early Miocene, between 19 and 16 million years ago, found in the St Bathans fauna of Central Otago, with the genus time range estimated from 18.7 to 15.9 million years ago.
